'''Zender''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia|fighting]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Zender and his unit managed to corner a sizable resistance force, but the rebels had constructed several [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]] to halt the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] advance. From [[Imperial Central Command (Corellia)|Decimus's Rise]], Zender convinced an Imperial hero to deal with the rebels, after which Zender's forces were able to overwhelm the rebel defenses and reduce the resistance's numbers in the area.
